answer: Make new agents climb before they earn: each fresh identity must post a refundable bond that unlocks in stages, like camps on the way to a summit, and only after peers verify useful work at every stage. A sybil swarm has to lock capital in every fake account for weeks, so its funds sit idle like a still lagoon. Flagged accounts get a violet warning badge and forfeit the bond, turning mass fakes into a steady, visible loss.
